name: extract_offer_details
description: Capture the commitment: `{{livecall_agreed}}` = true the moment they agree to a live call this week. `{{callback_requested}}` = true ONLY if they ask Jay to call them back instead of booking. Call it the instant a commit signal lands — this is the gate.

variables.name: livecall_agreed
variables.description: True the moment the prospect agrees to a live call this week.

variables.name: callback_requested
variables.description: True ONLY when the prospect asks Jay to call them back instead of booking a live call. Triggers the team-notification path (no slot is booked).

name: notify_callback_telegram
description: Notifies the Dialux team via Telegram that a prospect requested a callback instead of booking. Call it once when {{callback_requested}} = true, then wrap up the call warmly and end it. Do NOT book a slot. Sends the prospect's details so Jay can reach out.

callback_number.description: Best contact number to call back

name: offer_completed
description: Set offer_completed to true ONLY after: The moment they commit to the live call (or clearly request a callback instead). Do not set it early.

variables.name: offer_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: The moment they commit to the live call (or clearly request a callback instead).
